name: profileHydrator
body:
const profile = data.applicant_profile; if (!profile) return; const info = profile.personal_information; const skills = profile.technical_skills_competencies; const stackHtml = `
${skills.programming_languages.map(s => `${s}`).join('')}

${skills.system_design_experience}

${profile.experience_portfolio.personal_projects_open_source_contributions.map(p => `
${p.project_name}

${p.description}

`).join('')}
`; document.getElementById(targetId).insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', stackHtml); env.funcs.listener(targetId);
